tooth_bastion.label: The foreigner's tooth, the new bastion on the Travancore fort wall
tooth_bastion.anchor: A new angled star-fort bastion of red laterite and packed earth jutting from the old fort wall like a tooth, with a low stone parapet walk, steps up from the yard and one banner staff on its point: the royal standard, red with a silver conch, at the top, and below it a smaller pennant, white with a dark blue diagonal line crossed by a dark blue curved line. Below lie the flat red-dust drill ground, the scrub and wooded hills, with the sea only a distant line.
tooth_bastion.absent: No masonry castle towers, turrets or crenellated battlements, no blue-coated or red-coated soldiers, no hats on the two officers, no glass lanterns, and no lettering, numerals or extra emblems on the standard or the pennant.
tooth_bastion.time: last light of evening, long and gold across the drill ground

rampart_walk.label: Fort rampart walk above the palace roofs
rampart_walk.anchor: The long laterite rampart walk of the Travancore fort wall, a low parapet with lamp niches. On one side lies the drill ground; on the other the palace below, Kerala tiled roofs with steep gables and carved timber eaves stepping down toward the audience hall.
rampart_walk.absent: No domes, minarets, glass windows or European palace, no masonry castle towers, and no coats on the drill ground below: the men there wear white mundu.
rampart_walk.time: evening, dusk gathering over the roofs

palace_hall.label: Travancore palace hall
palace_hall.anchor: A long pillared palace hall with laterite walls, carved teak pillars and ceiling, a polished dark floor and open-wick brass lamps. Chiefs and officers sit along the walls on mats and low raised platforms, while Nagoji and De Lannoy stand together at the far end.
palace_hall.absent: No throne, European chairs, benches or glass lamps, no turbans on the Nair chiefs, and no coat on anyone but De Lannoy.
palace_hall.time: daylight through the open side, open-wick brass lamps

war_hall.label: Fort war hall with the map table
war_hall.anchor: The fort's war hall: timber pillars, laterite walls and a sloping tiled roof, maps of plain unlettered lines pinned to the walls, a long plain timber map table at which everyone stands, open-wick brass lamps and one timber-latticed window.
war_hall.absent: No chairs, benches, throne, glass lamps or chandeliers; no officer wears a coat except De Lannoy, the new white coat is never worn by anyone in this room, and Varma wears no turban or crest.

drill_ground.label: Drill ground below the new bastion
drill_ground.anchor: The flat red-dust drill ground at the foot of the laterite fort wall and its angled new bastion: marked posts for the riders, wooden targets in the scrub, a small field gun on braced wheels, the armoury wall with a strip of shade, and the gate to the yard. Firing lines are seen side-on, and anyone watching stands behind or beside the line, never before the muzzles.
drill_ground.absent: No blue-coated or red-coated soldiers, no tricornes, no European buildings, tents or glass lanterns, and no flag but the red conch standard.
drill_ground.time: dry-season daylight, red dust in the air

parade_ground.label: Fort parade ground, gate and stables
parade_ground.anchor: The fort's parade ground of packed red earth inside the laterite star-fort walls: squads in the new white coats at drill, a field gun on its carriage, the main gate, and a row of stables with tiled roofs and a water trough across the yard.
parade_ground.absent: No escort of foreign soldiers with the visiting embassy, no carriage, no European tents or glass lanterns, and no red-coated or blue-coated troops.

verandah.label: Lamplit verandah of a Kerala house
verandah.anchor: A raised laterite verandah under deep tiled eaves on carved timber posts, a woven mat, clay cups of toddy and an open-wick brass lamp, coconut palms dark beyond. Ibrahim and Padmini sit on the raised verandah ledge, her stick across her knees, with Nagoji beside them.
verandah.absent: No chairs, tables, glass lanterns or European furniture.
verandah.time: evening, brass and clay oil lamps

velinadu_courtyard.label: Revathi's courtyard at Velinadu
velinadu_courtyard.anchor: The sunlit inner courtyard of Revathi's house at Velinadu, open to the sky, with carved timber pillars and tiled eaves; she sits on a mat at a low table of palm-leaf accounts with a brass grain measure, an old steward beside her. An open gate looks south, and far off through it, small and grey above the palms, stands the angled point of the new bastion.
velinadu_courtyard.absent: No chairs or European furniture, no soldiers, no glass lanterns, and never a close or large view of the bastion.

goa_gaol.label: Goa gaol corridor and cell, remembered
goa_gaol.anchor: The Goa gaol of years before: low vaulted stone corridors slick with monsoon damp, wet flagstones, heavy iron-bound timber cell doors, and inside a cell a short chain with empty iron manacles hanging slack from a ring in the wall. Gaol guards wear dented steel morion helmets, loose off-white shirts, buff leather jerkins, dark breeches and buckled shoes.
goa_gaol.absent: Nothing red or blue on the gaol guards, no British red coats or Dutch blue coats, no nooses, no blood or body on the floor, never the officer's eyes, and no present-day Travancore figure.
goa_gaol.time: grey dawn light, cold and damp

goa_chamber.label: Goa interrogation chamber, remembered
goa_chamber.anchor: The interrogation chamber of the Goa gaol: vaulted stone thick enough to swallow sound, an iron ring in the vault, a brazier glowing red on the far side, a plain table and a bare stool in shadow.
goa_chamber.absent: No nooses, no blood or wounds, no instruments in use, no prisoner on the stool, and no present-day figure.

goa_courtyard.label: Goa gaol courtyard and gate, remembered
goa_courtyard.anchor: A Goa courtyard of whitewashed walls under a glaring sky, the frame burned almost to white, with the gate on the far side. Portuguese musketeers in broad tilted hats and buff leather coats, with matchlock muskets, line the walls.
goa_courtyard.absent: No British red coats or Dutch blue coats, nothing red or blue on the musketeers, no ship or harbour in view, and no present-day Travancore figure.

nagoji_quarters.label: Nagoji's quarters in the fort
nagoji_quarters.anchor: Nagoji's small bare quarters: lime-washed laterite walls, a rolled sleeping mat, a wooden peg on the wall, and a small round bronze mirror on the wall whose reflection is dim and warm.
nagoji_quarters.absent: No glass mirror, wardrobe, bed frame, chairs or other European furniture, and no glass lantern.
nagoji_quarters.time: soft daylight from a small shuttered window

temple_memory.label: The great temple, remembered
temple_memory.anchor: The great Padmanabhaswamy temple in hard daylight, remembered: the tall carved stone gopuram behind and the ring of belikal offering stones on stone paving.
temple_memory.absent: No blood, no priest, no attacker's face, no present-day figure, no coat or uniform, and no glass lamps.
temple_memory.time: hard bright daylight, pale and soft-edged as memory

artillery_yard.label: Fort artillery yard
artillery_yard.anchor: The fort's artillery yard of packed earth inside the laterite walls: bronze field guns on wooden carriages, rammers, sponges and a smouldering slow match, shot stacked apart from the powder under a tiled shed, and a cleared range running out to wooden targets. The crew stands in fixed places round the gun.
artillery_yard.absent: No altar, shrine or priest at the guns, no red-coated or blue-coated gunners, no glass lanterns, and no blood.
artillery_yard.time: dry-season daylight, white gun smoke drifting

river_dock.label: River dock below the fort wall
river_dock.anchor: A timber landing stage on a slow river below the laterite fort wall, coconut palms along the banks, and a small wooden country boat with a palm-thatch canopy pulled in beside stacked barrels and sacks of saltpetre.
river_dock.absent: No ocean-going ship, harbour quay, crane, brick warehouse or glass lantern on the landing.

lamplit_room.label: Lamplit room in the fort
lamplit_room.anchor: A small lamplit room in the fort with laterite walls and timber rafters, where Avraham, Thoma and Nagoji sit on a woven mat with account books and cargo manifests spread between them, brass cups of arrack and one open-wick brass lamp.
lamplit_room.absent: No chairs, dining table, glass bottles, drinking glasses or glass lanterns.

armoury.label: Small fort armoury
armoury.anchor: The fort's small armoury: laterite walls, timber racks of spears, a new shipment of talwars and straight blades in an opened crate, one open-wick brass lamp lit on a bracket, and an open door onto the yard where men drill.
armoury.absent: No glass lanterns, chairs or later-century firearms.
armoury.time: evening, last daylight slanting through the open door and one lit brass lamp

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, no beard or facial scar, no forehead mark, and a tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it. In the present he has first grey at the temples, a Kerala topknot, no turban, no bandages and no knife: on pages 1 to 13 a white mundu and shoulder cloth with bare arms and the silver chain of office, no coat; from page 14 the white coat with plain brass buttons and a red waistcoat, the silver chain worn over it.
character_notes.eustachius: Tall, pale hair tied back as on his sheet, bare-headed, pale freckled hands. A worn white Travancore coat patched at the elbows and frayed at the cuffs in every panel, never a blue coat and never a hat.
character_notes.varma: Face, moustache and build from his sheet with black hair, never the grey of the sheet's later figure; in the war hall bare-headed with his hair in a side knot above the LEFT ear, no turban, crest or headband, bare-chested in a cream mundu with a gold border and gold necklaces. A clean cloth bandage at the back of his LEFT shoulder in the war hall; in the temple stain on page 21 only his unbandaged shoulder in white silk shows.
character_notes.ramayyan: Thin sharp fine features and receding hair, plain unbordered white cloth, a palm-leaf bundle and stylus; no forehead marks or sacred thread.
character_notes.padmini: In her fifties: thick black hair coiled at the nape with the first grey threading it, simple gold, a cotton sari hitched for walking in the old Kerala drape with no stitched blouse, and her long walking stick.
character_notes.ibrahim: White turban, short grey-flecked beard and a thin pale scar from the anatomical LEFT ear to the jaw; a short coat over a vest with bulging pockets, nothing on the forehead.
character_notes.revathi: A little younger than Nagoji: deep indigo sari with gold, jasmine in her braid, flat-coin necklace, gold armlets, a sandalwood line at the hairline, a tali at her throat and the first grey threading her hair.
character_notes.keshavrao: About nineteen, narrow shoulders, black hair hacked short, a faint youthful moustache and no beard, a faded grey-brown torn tunic and no ear stud; he appears only in stains, never in the present.
character_notes.duarte: In the present on pages 15 to 20, the sheet's thin stooped priest made older and greyer, with ink-stained fingers and a plain black cassock with a plain standing collar and a small cross, never a white collar tab. In the stains on pages 16 and 19 he is more than a decade younger, his hair still dark with no grey.
character_notes.joao: Only his thick ruddy wrist and forearm appear, in a rolled cream shirt sleeve under a brown leather jerkin; never a face and never a cassock.
character_notes.prince: About fourteen in the present: the sheet's face and topknot but older, taller and leaner, beardless and narrow-shouldered, in a plain training tunic with no silks or jewels, and on page 26 the same white coat as the men. Only in the stains on pages 21 and 26 is he the small boy of about ten.
character_notes.senior_rani: Varma's sister, with the sheet's face and severely pulled-back hair, dressed in plain white without ornament; cool, unreadable and straight-backed.
character_notes.kayal: Nagoji's bay mare: an ochre red-brown coat with black mane, tail and lower legs, no white markings, sized between a Madurai charger and a Maravar pony.
character_notes.thoma: A broad-shouldered Syrian Christian artillery commander in a plain white cloth tunic, teeth stained dark red-brown with betel; never in priest's dress.
character_notes.avraham: A Kochi Jewish trader in a dark coat despite the heat and a cap, with a full beard falling to his chest; unsmiling.
